game_plan.early:
As a melee soft support you can't trade with the enemy heroes the traditional way. If your lane partner is a beefy hero who doesn't mind too much occasional harass by the enemy support, you can focus on harassing the enemy carry (if he's melee) and mess up his last hits with Bash & Charge.
You also rotate earlier than most other heroes in the game.
game_plan.mid: Bara is terrible at farming. Your best sources of income are pick offs, team fights & stacking camps. The majority of the hero's skillset comes from knowing when & what to do.
game_plan.late: The biggest change for you is that there are less pick offs & more team fights. You can fulfill this function, but you're rarely the initial initiator for fights. You're best at showing up & charging through the entire enemy team just as a fight is starting. Make sure to cause as much chaos in the enemy lines as possible.
game_plan.extras: As long as you have at least one active teammate looking to get kills with your help, one of your hero's best features is that most enemy players can't really split push or play by themselves on the map in general. Bad opponents will give you a lot of free pick off kills. Better opponents will play more tightly stacked together, but this also means that they're applying less pressure on the map & having less farm in general. As long as you don't fall into the mistake of forcing unnecessary fights for no good reason, you're already contributing immensely to your team simply by being a potential threat. Just like a Pudge missing on the map - you're causing fear into the hearts of your enemies!

skill_builds.name: Skill Build 1 — Standard
skill_builds.note: You can apply a lot of pressure on the enemy carry with Bashes from the get go.

skill_builds.name: Skill Build 2 — Kill on Bounty Runes
skill_builds.note: Sometimes Charge on the initial Bounty Runes can net you First Blood. And the spell is still usable in-lane by stunning the enemy carry & forcing him to miss a last hit. You also won't mess up the creep equilibrium doing this, since you don't have any points into Greater Bash to actually damage enemies around you.

item_builds.name: Item Build 1 — Choo Choo!
item_builds.note: The train never stops. Get aboard the Kill Express!

item_builds.name: Item Build 2 — Get behind me Mr. President!
item_builds.note: When playing against a lot of problematic target spells and you have a core who can auto-win you the game if he simply doesn't get hit by them - you're the perfect solution to this.

situational_items.note: When facing heavy slows from heroes like [hero:venomancer] & [hero:warlock], you can be of immense help to your team this way. They also naturally help you Bash more often if you're allowed to auto attack in fights.

When you're countering a lot of CC target spells with your [item:aghanims_shard], your [ability:spirit_breaker_bulldoze] is giving you all the Status Resistance that you need to get back on your feet asap. But when protecting an ally from hard nukes like [hero:lina] & [hero:lion]'s ultimates, you can just block their damage this way.

All the stats from [item:cyclone] are good for you. The item can be used to Dispel and CC an enemy hero or to buy yourself a few seconds when you find yourself in the middle of the enemy team and your team is following up on you. Later on [item:wind_waker] can be used to save allies as well as yourself from heavily focused damage.

In most games you get all that you need from the cheaper [item:invis_sword] which most notably is the ability to charge somebody with much less fear of being interrupted. As a non-farming support you have to prioritize your items more than most others. But when Break can counter an enemy hero hard - it's a natural upgrade for you.

In rare cases when facing spells that completely remove your impact from the game, you have to get Debuff Immunity so you don't just sit afk in every single fight. Think of heroes like [hero:mars], [hero:abyssal_underlord], [hero:disruptor], [hero:dark_willow], [hero:rattletrap] with big Area Denial spells. Keep in mind that you can also activate BKB mid-charge without interrupting it.

tips.text: Both [ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness] & [ability:spirit_breaker_nether_strike] apply a guaranteed proc of [ability:spirit_breaker_greater_bash] to enemies hit. [ability:spirit_breaker_greater_bash]'s damage is based on a % of your current Movement Speed at the moment of impact. This means that if you activate effects like [ability:spirit_breaker_bulldoze], [item:phase_boots], [item:ancient_janggo], [item:boots_of_bearing], you'll deal way more damage while also giving your opponents less time to react.

When charging into more than one hero, you should almost always try to charge the one positioned furthest behind in order to hit everyone else on your path as well - even if the person at the front is the primary target you want dead.

[ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness] provides vision around your target. Sometimes it's useful to charge somebody who's being chased by your teammates just for the vision alone - even if you won't be able to get to him on time. Especially useful against certain heroes like [hero:slark] who benefit extra from being in the Fog of War or any invisible hero since [item:dust] costs practically nothing and you can always pop it when you slam at your target.

You're at your weakest during the laning stage. If you master that, you'll be amazing at the hero. Against more passive opponents you can lane normally. But sometimes you're going to face high kill threat heroes & then you'll have to do creep cutting behind the enemy tower in order to survive the first couple of minutes of the game.

Prime your [ability:spirit_breaker_greater_bash]! On average you proc it once every 6 hits. This means that you can hit a creep a few times & prime your following attacks to have a near-certain chance of bashing. Keep in mind that applying [ability:spirit_breaker_greater_bash] with [ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness] does NOT reset your pseudo-random distribution sequence. So this technique works throughout the entirety of the game.
This way instead of applying 2 [ability:spirit_breaker_greater_bash] procs with [ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness] & [ability:spirit_breaker_nether_strike], you can easily make them 3 almost every single time.

When charging somebody for a kill and it's really important to pull him back towards your team, make sure to cast [ability:spirit_breaker_nether_strike] as soon as the [ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness] connects. This works even better with a Primed Bash, because you'll most likely bash him an extra time after you've knocked him back towards your allies with [ability:spirit_breaker_nether_strike].

You can pop an enemy's [item:sphere] from anywhere on the map instantly with [ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness]. While heroes often buy this item to protect themselves from instant initiation, you can enable your teammates by removing said protection just before they go in on the target.

You're one of the best heroes to fix waves pushing into your side of the map that nobody else wants to take, because you're hard to kill plus you can quickly return back to your team soon after. In a similar way if you're caught anywhere on the map, you can charge at any visible enemy unit anywhere on the map. Sometimes this might mean that you'll have to charge towards the enemy base, which albeit counterintuitive to new players, is actually perfectly fine since you can just stop mid-way and use [item:tpscroll] to safety.

[item:ultimate_scepter|spirit_breaker] is a must-have item for team fights and especially amazing vs deathball strategies where most if not all of the enemy heroes are always stacked together. It gives a chain-reaction effect to your [ability:spirit_breaker_greater_bash] - no matter how you apply it. It also increases the knockback distance of your bash by an extra one-third & doubles your ultimate's. This item suddenly makes you a priority target due to how much of an impact you'll have in such fights.

Your hero can arguably make more use of your Courier than any other hero in the game. You can place it at neutral camps beforehand. This way you can ensure that you'll have an available [ability:spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness] target at all times.

allies.note: High tempo heroes who want to find kills early & often but often require a setup to unload their damage.

counters.note: Any hero that relies on Debuff Immunity in order to stand their ground in fights. Mobile enemies.
